Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the pilot — the team is ready to move forward but Finance needs guidance on how we should account for the remaining promotional allowance. We currently have a $45,000 trial allowance on our ledger tied to the POC period.

Two questions:
- Can Redwood issue a proforma invoice for the post-trial committed usage and net the $45k allowance as an offset, or do you require a formal credit memo first?
- If we do a netting entry on our side, is there any supporting evidence Redwood can provide (approval email / credit authorization code) that our accounting team can attach to the journal?

I attached the proforma draft and the allowance schedule. Can you advise what routing we should follow so this clears without hitting suspense? We are on a month-end close next week and need to know by Friday.

Appreciate the help — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,

Hi Elena — thanks for the detail and for sending the attachments. Quick summary of how we can proceed so Finance can close cleanly: 

Option A (preferred for clean external audit trail):
- Redwood issues a formal credit memo for $45,000 referencing Deal ID DEAL-78431 and the pilot timeframe.
- You apply the credit memo to the proforma invoice; your AR team nets the amounts and records a cleared receivable.

Option B (works but needs documented authorization):
- We provide a signed approval email and an authorization reference that your accounting team can attach to your journal entry.
- You post a netting journal on your side and include Redwood's authorization in the supporting docs.

Operational notes and timing: 
- For Option A we need a short internal approval (sales + finance). Marcus — can you confirm authorization to issue the $45k credit memo?
- Neha — please advise whether we should route the credit as a credit memo (proforma reduction) or as a contra-revenue allowance for GL mapping (client prefers proforma reduction).
- Laura — if we issue a credit memo, do we need any additional fields on the document to satisfy SOX evidence for a third-party audit?

If we can confirm today I can generate the credit memo and sign it off; otherwise provide the written authorization (Option B) and we'll send the signed approval email within the hour.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call.

Thanks,
